del_timer_sync(&b->hangcheck);

cancel_fake_irq(engine);
__intel_breadcrumbs_disable_irq(b);
```

The fix involves explicitly canceling the timers and sanitizing the interrupt mask register (IMR) to ensure that the IRQ handling is reliable.
